'''Doni''' is a peasant boy living in [[Tear]].

==Activities==
When [[Rand al'Thor]] comes to Tear, Doni and [[Com]] tell him of the steamwagon from [[Cairhien]] driven by [[Mervin Poel]]. [[Min Farshaw]] has a [[Min's viewings|viewing]] that both of the boys will die. It is unknown if this has happened yet.
